promotion: No automatic promotion. Display target achievement, excess return versus both baselines, drawdown, exposure and cost sensitivity for all four groups.
news: No complete archived company-news tape is available for 2024-2025; hosted Qwen is separately tested and is not credited with this price-only P&L.
